# Dashboard Design

- Put high-value status and actions first.
- Avoid overcrowded KPI cards.
- Group related filters.
- Keep tables readable and scannable.
- Use consistent number/date formatting.
- Make status indicators understandable without relying only on color.
- Preserve usable layouts on smaller screens.
- Keep sidebars and navigation predictable.
